en: An old monochrome postcard image depicting a large fortified complex with towers, crenellated walls, and a mix of medieval and Renaissance architectural elements. In the foreground are a few people, carts, and early motor vehicles on a wide road. Trees frame the scene, with mountains faintly visible in the background. At the top of the postcard is printed the caption: "Trento - Castello del Buon Consiglio."
